name: Wall Corner Rack | Multipurpose Kitchen & Bathroom Corner Organizer | Metal Wall Mount Storage Rack
description:
Maximize your corner space with this Wall Corner Rack, perfect for bathrooms, kitchens, and sinks. Crafted from durable stainless steel, it’s designed to hold your essentials neatly while saving space and adding a modern touch to your home.

Key Features
Durable & Reliable: Made from high-quality stainless steel, resistant to rust and corrosion for long-lasting use.
Space-Saving Corner Design: Utilizes unused corner spaces effectively, keeping your essentials organized.
Heavy Load Capacity: Can hold up to 5kg (11lb) of items, perfect for soaps, shampoos, shower gels, cleaning supplies, and more.
Multipurpose Use: Ideal for bathrooms, kitchens, toilets, and sinks.
Easy Wall Mount: Sleek design allows simple installation on smooth, hard surfaces like tiles, marble, or tempered glass.

Product Details
Material: Stainless steel
Load Capacity: 5kg (11lb)
Installation: Wall-mounted on smooth hard surfaces
Dimensions: Standard corner shelf size

Benefits
Keeps bathroom and kitchen items organized and accessible
Maximizes corner storage space
Rust-resistant and durable for long-term use
Stylish addition to modern interiors
